product_family: Social listening and media monitoring platform that tracks mentions across 1 billion+ web and social media sources with real-time monitoring, sentiment analysis, competitive intelligence, and brand reputation management. Acquired by Agorapulse in April 2025.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: Mention references AWS SOC 2 certifications as infrastructure provider: 'Servers hosted on AWS...AWS maintains SOC 2/SSAE 16 compliance' (https://mention.com/en/terms-and-conditions/). Parent company Agorapulse holds SOC 2 Type II via Vanta, but scope coverage of Mention product post-acquisition (May 2025) is not explicitly stated. AWS certification is infrastructure-level, not Mention's own certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Mention references AWS ISO 27001 certification as infrastructure provider. AWS maintains ISO 27001 compliance as hosting provider, but Mention does not hold independent ISO 27001 certification. No public evidence of Mention-level ISO 27001 certification found.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance & DPA
certifications.proof_quote: Terms page states verbatim: 'If you, as a data controller, require Mention to agree to data protection requirements under Article 28, GDPR, or under UK data protection laws, Mention makes available a data processing addendum.' It also states 'under the GDPR, you have the right to request a copy of your personal data which are processed by Mention.' Data protection officer contact listed as gdpr@mention.com.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or HIPAA BAA offering found on Mention website, privacy policy, or trust documentation.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS compliance for Mention product found. While AWS may be PCI-compliant as a host, Mention does not claim independent PCI DSS compliance.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 certification for Mention found.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (PII Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification for Mention found.

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27701 certification for Mention found.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 or other AI governance certifications found. Mention advertises 'AI tools' and sentiment analysis but does not claim AI governance certifications.

privacy.ai_training_note: Mention features sentiment analysis and AI tools prominently on homepage and product pages. However, no explicit statement found regarding whether Mention trains on user data, whether user monitoring data is used for model improvement, or whether customers have opt-out rights for AI training. This should be clarified in vendor conversation.

flags: Mention references AWS SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications on its terms page, but these belong to its infrastructure provider (AWS) and are not Mention's own independent certifications, which can create confusion about who is responsible for what.

Mention was acquired by Agorapulse in May 2025. While Agorapulse holds SOC 2 Type II (via Vanta), it is not explicitly stated whether this certification covers the Mention product; ask the vendor for scope documentation.

Mention advertises 'AI tools' and sentiment analysis features prominently, but the privacy policy does not explicitly state whether Mention trains its ML models on user monitoring data, whether there is an opt-out, or how customer data is used for model improvement. Customers who care about AI data use should ask the vendor directly.

Mention underwent court-ordered receivership prior to the Agorapulse acquisition, indicating past financial distress. The product is now stable under Agorapulse ownership, but this history is worth weighing when considering long-term viability.

Mention's Publish & Respond (engagement) features were retired on January 30, 2026, with customers directed to Agorapulse instead. This signals ongoing product consolidation and the potential for further feature deprecation.

The Data Protection Officer contact listed on Mention's terms page is gdpr@mention.com (a Mention domain address). Privacy documentation additionally references Agorapulse, consistent with post-acquisition integration.
There is no evidence of HIPAA or PCI DSS compliance; Mention is not positioned for healthcare or payment card industry use cases.
